messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Our Maintenance Subdivision is doing a scheduled On-line Banking software update', 'You need to upgrade now', 'Due to ongoing maintenance upgrade at Halifax, all customers are required to update their information to the new security system to enable a faster, easier and more secure online banking experience.', 'Our Technical services Department are carrying out a planned software upgrade for the maximum convenience of the users of online-services of the Halifax Online Banking.', 'Due to this recent development A temporary change has occurred that require you to connect to a different server.', 'Our Support Department is running a planned On-line Banking software upgrade', 'NOTE: This form must be in a modern browser that has to be opened JavaScript enabled (ex: Internet Explorer, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera)', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We are performing scheduled online banking software and security upgrades to improve service, requiring customers to update information, connect to new servers, and use compatible browsers."}
